chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from al-Mughira ibn Tuba, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them). He said:

When the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) looked over the graveyards, he said: O people of the dust! O people of estrangement! As for your houses, they have been reinhabited. As for your wives, they have been remarried. As for your wealth, it has been distributed. This is the news from our side; so what is the news from your side?
Then he turned to his companions and said: If they were permitted to speak, they would have informed you that the best provision is God-wariness.

key_terms.التقوى: Taqwa, God-wariness/piety, the Quranic concept of God-consciousness
key_terms.الزاد: Provision, supplies for a journey -- metaphor for what one carries to the afterlife

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when he visited the graveyard about the best provision?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) addressed the dead in the graveyard, reminding them that life has moved on without them -- their homes are inhabited by others, their wives have remarried, and their wealth has been distributed. He then told his companions that the dead, if they could speak, would attest that the best provision one can carry is taqwa (God-consciousness). This hadith, narrated through Imam al-Sadiq from the Imams, underscores the transient nature of worldly possessions and the enduring value of piety.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi from his father from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from al-Mughira b. Tuba from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his grandfather (as). He said:

When Amir al-Mu’minin (as) inspected the graveyards, he said: O people of the dust! O people of estrangement! As for your houses, they have been reinhabited. As for your wives, they have been remarried. As for your wealth, it has been distributed. This is the news from our side, what about the news from your side?
Then, he turned to his companions and said: If they were permitted to speak, they would have informed you that the best provision is God-wariness.
